text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: elevated 5xx rate for inference API (region: us-west-2). Pager dispatched to rotation. Details: error spike at 19:02 UTC. Root thread start.

lisa: Paging in. seeing ~15% 5xx on /v1/generate starting ~19:01. Affected customers: some dedicated pools and hosted small-tenants. Crash rates correlate with increased tail latency.

raj: On it. Any obvious deploys around 19:00? I'll check deploy bot.

miguel: I'm seeing a related alert for gpu-pool-12 hitting OOM evictions around 18:59. Could be autoscaler churn. attaching quick query:
```
# metrics query (promql)
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (instance)
```

lisa: Thanks. Can someone pull the request logs for a few failed request_ids? I'm not seeing them in the default logs view — looks sparse.

eva: I tried `request_id=abf3-xxxx` and only found metadata, no full proxy logs. Dashboards show sampling=1% for proxy logs in us-west though we expect 100% for errors. Did something flip? :eyes: 

raj: I can confirm sampling flag `LOG_SAMPLING_PCT` was set to `1` in the proxy config map during the 18:50 deploy. Was supposed to be a canary change but somehow rolled to all pods. Hypothesis: canary label selector misapplied.

miguel: That would explain missing request bodies and KV cache traces. Need full logs to reconstruct timeline. Can we temporarily bump sampling to 100%?

lisa: Agreed — we need more signal now. Also customers are seeing `503 Service Unavailable` on heavy prompts. Let's apply sampling change and scale up nodes.

raj: Executing rollback-ish change now:
```
# kubectl
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/proxy LOG_SAMPLING_PCT=100
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/proxy
```

oncall-bot: Change detected: env update for daemonset/proxy by raj. Rollout started.

miguel: While that rolls, here's an ad-hoc query to find recent 5xx for a tenant:
```
# logsql
source=proxy_logs | where tenant_id=="tenant-42" and status>=500 | top 50 by timestamp
```

lisa: I can see logs flowing in now for the failed request_ids — we have stack traces pointing to `kv-cache` returning unexpected null on cold-start. Here's a sample line:
```
ERROR kv-cache: missing-key tenant=tenant-42 key=ctx-9a3f trace_id=abf3-xxxx latency_ms=213
```

eva: Cross-checking customer impact: two paying customers saw ~5-10% failure rate in the last 10m. CS warned one sent an incident email. Need communication.

lisa: I'll post an incident update to #customer-status: "We've identified degraded inference availability due to a logging sampling misconfiguration that coincided with an autoscaler event. We're restoring full sampling and scaling capacity. Customers may see intermittent errors; mitigation in progress."

sre-rotation: For mitigation, suggest suspend autoscaler temporarily for gpu-pool-12 to prevent churn while we stabilize.

raj: Doing that now:
```
kubectl -n infra patch hpa gpu-pool-12 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4,"maxReplicas":4}}'
```

oncall-bot: Manual update: HPA patched by raj. Autoscaler suspended to 4 replicas.

miguel: After sampling and stabilization, 5xx rate dropped to baseline (~0.2%). Rolling metric window shows recovery starting 19:18 UTC.

lisa: Good. For RCA notes: earliest event at 18:50 deploy that changed proxy sampling to 1% via canary. Autoscaler then removed pods, which removed some cache priming and exposed kv-cache nulls. Missing logs delayed detection because sampling omitted trace payloads.

eva: Action items: (1) create RCA ticket with timeline + PR link, (2) add deployment guard for sampling env flips, (3) adjust dashboards to show sampling % and log availability, (4) surface per-tenant log sampling in console.

miguel: Adding the audit link: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/abc123 change to proxy canary selector.

lisa: Handing off to next oncall @sre-rotation — summary: sampling accidentally lowered during canary -> missing logs -> autoscaler churn exposed kv-cache bug -> mitigated by restoring sampling + pinning replicas. Next steps: full RCA, test fix for kv-cache null on cold start, add deploy guard.

sre-rotation: Acknowledged. I'll keep watch and open the RCA ticket (INC-1943056789) and assign owners. Leaving notes for the oncoming shift: look for any regressions in the next 24h and confirm CS updates were sent. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident resolved? Monitoring will continue for 60m. If errors reappear, pager will fire again. :heartbeat:

lisa: Thanks all. We'll include the missing-logs observability checks in the RCA write-up. :memo:
